business_summary: Zhejiang Liju Thermal Equipment Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of commercial and industrial boilers in China and internationally. The company offers gas-fired hot water, gas-fired steam, electrode hot water, and electrode steam boilers. It also provides commissioning, training, and remote monitoring system services. Zhejiang Liju Thermal Equipment Co. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
